user.title: Connect to Able to Use
user.description: Enter your Able to Use email and password. Leave the Firebase project key blank to use the bundled Android app key.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Able to Use
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with the same Able account to resume control and status updates. Leave the project key blank to keep the existing setting.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Able cloud or read the account's devices
error.invalid_auth: Able rejected the sign-in. Check the email and password or supply an updated project key

abort.already_configured: This Able account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the Able account already configured for this entry
